question: The **price of wheat in flour **can be included in the _______ method of measuring national income.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Value Added.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Value added method:-**

 
 
• **The value-added method is an economic measure that calculates the national income by adding the value added at each stage of production. **
 
• In the case of wheat, the value added would be the difference between the price of the wheat and the price of the flour.
 
• This difference represents the value that was added by the milling process.

t into flour is a part of the value added method of measuring national income. **
